descriptions.notStarted: I've heard that #p2060005# has furthered his research and found a way to upgrade my existing mount.  A faster monster to ride?  I should go see #p2060005# in Aqua Road immediately!
descriptions.inProgress:
I visited the Aquarium and #p2060005# has indeed found a way to make the mounts bigger, faster and stronger! However, he needs #b#t4000264#, #t4000266#, and #t4000267##k to make the experiement a success.  He asked for a "donation" of 50 million mesos to develop the technology for monster and human to co-exist. That's some expensive research! He must be raking it in...

descriptions.completed: It took a bit of time, but I returned with the needed items and "donation" he asked for. #p2060005# made my #t1902000# into a #t1902001#.  What a difference! My mount is so much sharper and stronger than before! I can run over almost anything now!
